reason.actual_scope_basis: The authorized scope admits an actual core procedural rule without importing an unavailable effect. The Urgency sidebar is an ordinary original-rulebook permission attached to the Spirit Phase. The supplied scope does not exclude all table-administration actor permissions; inventing that exclusion would also be inconsistent with treating Q55’s decision-ownership procedure as eligible.
reason.operative_permission_vs_advice: The sentence Any player may place a limit expressly identifies an actor and a permitted action for a defined phase. It is a discrete optional permission. The opening flavour and final cooperative caution are advice surrounding that operative sentence; they do not convert the actor permission into a purely descriptive recommendation.
reason.optional_permission_not_optional_difficu: The question asks who may exercise a printed ordinary-phase permission. It does not introduce a scenario, adversary, optional difficulty/scoring system or compulsory timed variant.
reason.producer_requirement: No Power producer is needed. The original CORE p8 sentence is itself the actual procedure/actor authorization. No timer component, new modifier, event, trigger or card effect is assumed.
reason.boundary: This narrow acceptance does not claim all etiquette is procedural coverage. It covers the explicit any-player permission only, without an invented expiry penalty, duration, compulsory clock or override of unfinished game procedures.
